body: C60 is ready and its brief has changed - re-read research/TASK_C60.md, do not work from an earlier copy. Three changes: (1) the C59 gate is gone, C59 landed in d9f7da9; (2) RingPlace.gd HAS landed (Grok's G27, f0013d1, 63 lines) and I have already reviewed it cell by cell against the contract and found it correct - still write your assertions from the contract first, and report a disagreement rather than editing either side; (3) a RULING is pinned that you must read before assertion 3. The contract contradicted itself on one input - a recognised place in the wrong case plus an unrecognised step, advance('centre','typo'). Unchanged wins: the argument echoes back verbatim in whatever case it arrived, and 'return always UPPERCASE' applies only when a real transition happens. That ambiguity was mine, not Grok's. Assertion 6 now pins both halves in one test. Suite gate is fails=2 or better (Q11's migration regression, Qwen is on it under Q12); if Q12 has landed it is fails=0.
